Summary

  • Charles Hood, MD is an Internal Medicine specialist based in Scottsboro, AL with a subspecialty in Pain Medicine. Dr. Hood completed his medical studies at Vanderbilt University School of Medicine in 1967, followed by an internal medicine internship at Vanderbilt University Medical Center. He then proceeded to Stanford Health Care-Sponsored Stanford University for his residency in Internal Medicine, and subsequently a fellowship in Hematology. Dr. Hood has a publication titled "Factors affecting mortality of gram-negative rod bacteremia" in the Archives of Internal Medicine which was cited 221 times by other publications.
